parameters.name: Cak
parameters.description: The passphrase. Only hexadecimal characters are supported. Lowercase characters are automatically transformed to uppercase. When the encryption algorithm type is GCM-AES-128 or GCM-AES-XPN-128, the length must be 32 hexadecimal characters. When the encryption algorithm type is GCM-AES-256 or GCM-AES-XPN-256, the length must be 64 hexadecimal characters.

parameters.name: CipherSuite
parameters.description:
The encryption algorithm type. Valid values:

- GCM-AES-128

- GCM-AES-XPN-128

- GCM-AES-256

- GCM-AES-XPN-256

parameters.name: Ckn
parameters.description: The key name. Only hexadecimal characters are supported. Lowercase characters are automatically transformed to uppercase. When the encryption algorithm type is GCM-AES-128 or GCM-AES-XPN-128, the length must be 32 hexadecimal characters. When the encryption algorithm type is GCM-AES-256 or GCM-AES-XPN-256, the length must be 64 hexadecimal characters.

parameters.name: PhysicalConnectionId
parameters.description: The ID of the Express Connect circuit. The Express Connect circuit must be a dedicated circuit that has completed payment, supports MACsec, and is in the **Enabled** state. You can call DescribePhysicalConnections to query the current status and device capabilities.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Express Connect circuit.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~448570~~) operation to query region IDs.
